messages:
jo: Quick follow-up from today's tri-mode sync. We still don't have a final answer for how adapters should annotate origin + fallback without creating OOM in metrics. I prototyped a small contract, want quick take.

sam: Short answer: keep metrics low-cardinality, traces may carry full context only when sampled and authorized.

henri: For SLOs we need three pieces: hosting_kind, route_state, and model_signal_bucket. Add routing_version and fallback_cause for triage. Make these enums.

jo: My proposed enums: hosting_kind=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PRIVATE; route_state=PREFERRED|FALLBACK|SAFE_DEGRADED; model_signal_bucket=perf|balanced|accurate|other; fallback_cause=none|capacity|compat|auth|quota. routing_version should be short tokens like v1/v2.

vik (security): We must NOT emit tenant identifiers or raw model names into hosted metrics. For private deployments customers can enable richer tags into their own pipelines. Any trace that includes request payload must be opt-in per customer config and go to an encrypted audit store.

sam: Implementation detail: propagate via lightweight headers at the first runtime hop so adapters can preserve/override them on handoff. Example headers (draft):
```
X-RW-Host-Kind: DEDICATED
X-RW-Route-State: FALLBACK
X-RW-Model-Bucket: perf
X-RW-Routing-Ver: v2
X-RW-Fallback-Cause: capacity
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/1000
```
This lets exporters keep metrics simple and lets sampled traces include model_name or variant_id when allowed.

henri: Runtime should maintain a mapping: model_name -> model_signal_bucket. New entries default to "other" and raise an ops alert. Mapping is a small config blob updated via controlled rollout.

jo: Edge-case: multi-hop fallbacks (hosted -> dedicated -> private). Suggest precedence rule: hosting_kind = first non-UNKNOWN value; route_state = most_degraded seen (if any stage uses FALLBACK or SAFE_DEGRADED mark that). That keeps dashboards consistent.

vik (security): Also propose default TTL for sampled trace payloads (30 days) and a retention exceptions workflow for compliance. I'll add this to the telemetry policy draft.

sam: Exporter should canonicalize unexpected tag values to "other" and emit an alert so we don't get cardinality leaks from typos or new model names.

ops-bot: Heads-up: runtime deploy window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tag @sam if you want the slot. :calendar: 

jo: Action items: jo: update RFC with enums, headers, and precedence rules; sam: PR for header emit + exporter canonicalization; henri: mapping table design + alerting; vik: telemetry policy blurb. I'll post RFC patch by EOD tomorrow.

sam: I'll take the deploy slot and open the PR.
